services.name: Night Shift 2026
services.desc: Night Shift is an annual late-night fest that celebrates the many dance forms explored and practiced by Ontario-based artists. Initiated by Citadel + Compagnie in 2019, and co-presented with Fall for Dance North, Night Shift is a unique platform that showcases innovative and thought-provoking dance by today’s dynamic movement makers. services.name: Citadel Dance Program
services.desc: Join the Citadel Dance Program, offering Saturday classes in Creative Movement, Ballet, Bharatanatyam and Tap. Established in 2012, the Citadel Dance Program (CDP) provides weekend dance classes for children and youth in our local community of Regent Park. Our mandate is to make dance both accessible and visible to those living in our neighbourhood and to empower youth through the arts. We welcome students of all levels of training and experience - from curious beginners to practiced movers - and work to foster a positive, inclusive environment that supports the individual development and creative expression of each student.
